target_customer: Busy urban Indian women who need fitted blouses and ethnic wear
problem: Saree blouses must fit closely, and local tailoring is fragmented with a low NPS and requires shop visits and repeated back and forth.
business_model: D2C apparel brand: made-to-measure at launch, now readymade sized clothing sold online and through an app

founders.name: Aamna Khan
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch (2019-08-13) calls her an experienced product manager who worked with Vardhan for three years at Simpl.

founders.name: Raj Vardhan
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch calls him a data scientist.

competitors.name: RedThread
competitors.what: US startup using body scanning and algorithms to customize clothing

competitors.name: House of Blouse
competitors.what: Indian online seller of custom and readymade saree blouses
competitors.traction_then: said 90 percent of customers got sizing right on first order

technical_complexity.rationale: Size prediction and a factory to consumer made-to-measure pipeline with home fittings needed data science and operations; TechCrunch describes an algorithmic approach.

defensibility.rationale: Binks later cites a sizing chart built from measurements of 30,000 women, but at founding the advantage was operational and copyable by boutiques.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying the made-to-measure model; Binks itself moved toward readymade sized blouses.

market_need_then: The YC description cites a fragmented tailoring market with low NPS and busy urban women; TechCrunch (2019-08) reports high apparel return rates in India driven by fit.

identity.visual_style: Fashion e-commerce imagery with named fit technologies FlexiFit, StretchFit, SculptFit, CinchFit and BreezeFit
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and confident, fit first, framed around removing tailoring hassle

branding.community_and_virality: Reposts customer reviews on Instagram; no press about the brand itself found.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear product naming and consistent voice, but no evidence of press, merch or community beyond ordinary social posts.

pivots.to: Readymade blouses on a proprietary size chart plus broader ethnic wear
pivots.why: Not stated by a source; inferred from the YC page versus the current site, so date unknown.

outcome_analysis: Binks entered YC Summer 2019 with a made-to-measure blouse model and a seed of about 150 thousand dollars. The YC page lists 70 people and an active status, and the current site sells readymade sized blouses and a wider ethnic wear range with named fit systems. No later priced round was found, so scale and profitability are unknown, but the company has survived and grown headcount without any reported layoffs.
notes: The $150K seed rests on CB Insights and Seedtable (YC lead, Day Zero Ventures and Supermorpheus participating), both aggregators; the Day Zero Ventures 2019 post was seen only in search results. Founder education not found. Name origin not found. Headcount sources conflict (22 to 70).
